$comment: THE TEN OB-4 REFUSALS — criterion C1.

pipeline repository, and cross-checked against the count P2_COMPLETION_CONTRACT.md states in
words. Do not edit by hand: --check re-derives and compares, so an edit here is a lie that is
C1 requires ONE TEST PER REFUSAL, NAMED BY THE REFUSAL. The gate matches test names against
the `obligation` text below, so a test that drifts from its obligation stops matching rather

refusals.why: three of four is a state no `packVersion` names and nothing has validated. A half-imported graph is worse than no import: no import leaves a device on data it has been running correctly on
a refusal must cost the device nothing but CPU. Verification is phase 1 and writes nothing, so "the prior state is intact" is true by construction rather than by recovery
a partial file write inside it is unrecoverable. Stage beside, then two renames

refusals.obligation: **Roll back** at startup when a backup is present
refusals.why: the staged set is exactly the one whose promotion failed; rolling forward would promote it again
a constant a pack can influence is not a check
same reason. A trust store a pack could supply answers "is this signed by whoever signed it?"

refusals.obligation: Report `DATASET_ID_REFUSED` distinctly from a signature failure
refusals.why: "this is not our data" and "this may have been altered" are different problems; reporting the second for the first sends a user hunting for corruption that is not there

refusals.obligation: Treat a cross-pack-set reference miss as **absent**
refusals.why: §6 — that is content skew, and it is legal (see OB-2)
an adapter reading a format it does not understand either crashes or silently misreads, and misreading a financial field is the worse outcome

refusals.obligation: Hold **one estate generation** at a time
refusals.why: two packs can carry the right `datasetId` and describe different corpora

p1DidNotProve: **Three things P1 did NOT prove, and P2 must not assume:** a real power-loss crash (the interruptions are injected exceptions); concurrent importers (one at a time is assumed — a P2 runtime that can start an import while another runs needs a lock); and a rename failing for lack of disk space.
